subject: Action required: declined payment + chargeback on Jan invoice — assistance to update card
messages:
From: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@acme-corp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Accounting <billing@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Declined payment & bank chargeback for Jan invoice

Hi Monica,

We're seeing that the payment for invoice #202601 (USD 18,450) was declined on Jan 31 and our bank shows a pending chargeback that was submitted this morning. I'm attaching a redacted bank statement and the invoice.

We didn't intend to dispute — our AP ran into a card tokenization issue and retried the same card. Can Redwood re-run the charge on an updated card? If needed, I can provide a new card or have our AP portal update the payment method. We urgently need confirmation before Stripe marks the dispute final.

Attaching: invoice_202601.pdf (pdf), bank_statement_acme_jan2026.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Jamie Ross
Head of Finance
Acme Corp

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Declined payment & bank chargeback for Jan invoice

Hi Jamie — thanks for the heads up and for sending the statement. Sorry for the trouble.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I flagged the invoice and hold any automated collections attempts.
- I opened a dispute case with Stripe and added the attached evidence you provided.
- We can process a manual charge if you provide a new card (last 4 digits only in email is fine) or if you update the payment method in our billing portal.

Two options for you:
1) Update card in the billing portal: https://billing.redwoodinference.com/acme/invoice/202601 — select "Update payment method" and confirm.
2) Reply with the last 4 digits + month/year (no full card numbers in email) and I will route it to our billing ops to attempt a manual charge once you confirm authorization.

Stephanie, can you validate if we should put a comment on the HubSpot deal and set a 7-day recovery SLA?

Monica Patel
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Declined payment & bank chargeback for Jan invoice

On Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 10:03 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Jamie — thanks for the heads up and for sending the statement. Sorry for the trouble.
>
> Quick summary of next steps from our side:
> - I flagged the invoice and hold any automated collections attempts.
> - I opened a dispute case with Stripe and added the attached evidence you provided.
> - We can process a manual charge if you provide a new card (last 4 digits only in email is fine) or if you update the payment method in our billing portal.

Monica — I added a note in HubSpot (link below) and set a 7-day recovery SLA. I'll coordinate with CS if we need to escalate for any credit hold.

HubSpot note: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/98765

Aditya — if we get a reauthorization in writing from Acme, please schedule a manual capture and attach evidence to the Stripe dispute.

Thanks,
Steph
Account Executive (Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@acme-corp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Accounting <billing@acme-corp.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Declined payment & bank chargeback for Jan invoice

Thanks Monica — I've asked AP to update the card on the portal. In the meantime, we can authorize a manual charge: last 4 digits 4242, exp 10/27. Please consider this email authorization to charge that card for invoice #202601.

Apologies for the mess; our onboarding of a new payment vendor caused token duplication. Please proceed and confirm once processed.

Jamie

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@acme-corp.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 13:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Declined payment & bank chargeback for Jan invoice

Hi Jamie — thanks for the authorization. Per our PCI-safe process, I cannot accept full card numbers by email but last 4 digits + exp are fine. I'll attempt a manual capture now and will update the Stripe dispute with proof of authorization and the bank statement you attached.

If the manual capture fails due to the open dispute, we'll request a chargeback reversal from Stripe using the evidence you provided. Either way, I'll keep you posted within the hour.

---
[10:24 AM] Manual capture attempt: pending (Stripe returned code: dispute_open)
---

I'll follow up when I have the definitive outcome.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Ross <jamie.ross@acme-corp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Declined payment & bank chargeback for Jan invoice

Hi all — quick update from our side: our AP vendor confirmed they erroneously submitted the dispute. They have retracted the challenge and submitted a reauthorization to Stripe. You should see the dispute status change to "withdrawn" in the Stripe console shortly.

Please proceed with the manual capture on the 4242 card once Stripe shows withdrawn. Let me know if you need a signed authorization form; happy to send one if Stripe wants it for the reversal.

Appreciate the quick coordination — Jamie
Head of Finance, Acme Corp
